The '''Original TaunTaun Steak Company''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|diner]] aboard the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]]<ref name="Dash" /> in [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.1}}</ref> Its employees included the [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Nuura Yendo]] and a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Unidentified Rodian cook|line cook]]. It was the small, founding 8-seat location of the famed [[TaunTaun Steak Company]].<ref name="Dash" />
